Field pack: best flying lap for all 22 cars with OpenF1 car_data — switch driver in the header.

Synthetic front-left (Brakes.FrontLeft.Temperature shape) peaks at 688°C in the same heavy where rear brake_temp hits 942°C. Front stays under the public example warning of 700°C — rear duct, not a whole-axle loss.
Synthetic brake_pressure is shaped from OpenF1 brake (0/100) times speed. Peak 71.7 bar near 3689 m while speed is still 213 km/h, then 37.5 bar at the release — a trail, not a late stab.
Synthetic coolant_temp drifts 94.1°C → 98.2°C over the lap. Through the heavy it only moves 96.6→96.8°C — no post-brake soak step.
OpenF1 drs is 0 on every sample in this FP2 pack. LEC's fastest stretch still peaks at 332 km/h with DRS off.
OpenF1 n_gear holds 8 for 726 m (2986–3712 m) on the Soft flyer.
Synthetic tyre_surf_fl peaks at 128°C through S2 on the Soft flyer vs 105°C on the Hard push. Overlay only — no team tyre sensor.
Synthetic steering peaks at 26° near 583 m (from OpenF1 location curvature on the Soft flyer). Not a SECU steer sensor.
Synthetic g_long troughs at -1.97 g in the S3 heavy (derived from OpenF1 speed). Matches the brake-pressure trail window.
Synthetic fuel_flow (ATLAS FuelFlow-style) peaks at 110 kg/h through S2 on throttle — shaped from OpenF1 throttle × rpm, not a team fuel meter.
OpenF1 speed trap: Soft flyer st_speed 319 km/h vs Hard 314 km/h (Δ +5). Intermediate traps I1 221 / I2 183 km/h.
OpenF1 stint map: LEC Soft stint 2 covers laps 9–11 (tyre age at start 0). L10 Soft flyer sits in that stint.
OpenF1 weather series: track temp falls 42.4→39.1°C over FP2 (Δ −3.3°C). Air stays ~29.7–29.3°C. Soft flyer ran mid-session.
OpenF1 published 12 team-radio clips for this FP2; 0 are for car 16 (LEC). No LEC audio in the public subset.
OpenF1 pit: LEC entered the lane on lap 9 · lane 311.8s ahead of the Soft stint that includes the L10 flyer.
Teammate Soft flyers: LEC L10 1:35.291 vs HAM L9 1:35.906 (Δ −615 ms). Same OpenF1 st_speed 319 km/h — gap is mostly S2.
FP2 best-flyer order (OpenF1): LEC 1:35.291, ANT 1:35.333, VER 1:35.480, RUS 1:35.793, HAM 1:35.906. Full field of 22 cars in the pack.
Pack scope: 2026 US GP · COTA · FP2 · 22 drivers · 5513 m. OpenF1 car_data (speed/throttle/brake/rpm/gear/DRS) plus synthetic ATLAS-like overlays labeled OVL. Not a race result or championship feed.
OF1 = broadcast OpenF1 channels. OVL = synthetic ATLAS-shaped overlays (brake_temp, tyre_surf, fuel_flow, …). Money-shot thermal peak is OVL on an OF1 brake zone — both stay labeled on the wall.
Race control for car 16: multiple track-limits deletions (T19, T20, T18, T12) plus a Turn 18 incident with car 63 (RUS) that ended NO FURTHER ACTION. Rain risk for FP2 was 0%.
LEC programme times: L7 Hard 1:36.510 (S 25.775 / 38.396 / 32.339), L10 Soft 1:35.291 (25.630 / 37.834 / 31.827), L14 Soft long-run 1:40.691. Soft vs Hard Δ −1.219 s, mostly S2.
Race control: RISK OF RAIN FOR F1 FREE PRACTICE 2 IS 0%. OpenF1 weather rainfall stays 0; humidity ~23–25%; air ~29.7→29.3°C.
